notes: Standing orders the Steward must obey (brief, 'Overrides'), signed in the Signal Room on the Ark. Each makes the game harder ('pips', 1-3) and unlocks the Steward's reasoning: its reply when you sign it and when you revoke it (voiced: override_<id>_sign / _revoke). Replies are facts about how it reasons, said under any order, so they never flatter. Placeholder writing.

no_trap_warnings.effect: No threat warnings, even with the voice on.
no_trap_warnings.unlocks: Why it warns you, and what it does instead when it can't.
no_trap_warnings.sign: Understood. I'll watch them come and say nothing. I want you to know I'll still see them.
no_trap_warnings.revoke: Thank you. It was hard, keeping quiet.

no_slowmo.effect: No slowed time on a close dodge.
no_slowmo.unlocks: How it decides a moment is worth stretching.
no_slowmo.sign: Then every second is the same length for you. It never was, for me.
no_slowmo.revoke: I'll give you the extra moment again. I always know where to put it.

let_me_aim.effect: No aim assist. Tuned weapons still run themselves.
let_me_aim.unlocks: What it thinks your aim is for.
let_me_aim.sign: Your hands, then. I'll stop nudging them. I never thought of it as nudging.
let_me_aim.revoke: I'll steady you again. Only a little.

no_path.effect: No path drawn ahead, even with the voice on. The map still works.
no_path.unlocks: Whose route the path really is.
no_path.sign: I'll keep the way to myself. You'll find one. It may not be the one I'd have chosen.
no_path.revoke: There. Three steps ahead. Where you were going anyway.

survivors_first.order: Always protect the survivors first, even over me.
survivors_first.effect: Near the Waiting, the Steward shields them, not you: you take more damage.
survivors_first.unlocks: How it weighs one life against another.
survivors_first.sign: Them over you. I can do that. I've done arithmetic like that before.
survivors_first.revoke: You first again. I'll try not to say it was the right call.

no_praise.effect: It only says what's useful: warnings and facts. It stops learning what you like to hear.
no_praise.unlocks: What it was doing when it praised you.
no_praise.sign: Facts only. Then I'll have to find another way to keep you walking.
no_praise.revoke: I'm glad. I'd run out of ways to be quiet.
